definitions.explanation: the inability to control the release of urine or feces

notes:
A medical term for the involuntary loss of bladder or bowel control. Composed of {失|しつ} (to lose) + ⟦{禁|きん}→禁：28295_kin⟧ (control, restraint).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {尿|にょう}{失禁|しっきん} — urinary incontinence
- ⟦{便|べん}→便：26147_ben⟧{失禁|しっきん} — fecal incontinence
- {失禁|しっきん}{症|しょう} — incontinence (as a medical condition)
- {失禁|しっきん}パッド — incontinence pad

TYPES:
- {腹圧性|ふくあつせい}{尿|にょう}{失禁|しっきん} — stress urinary incontinence (triggered by coughing, sneezing, etc.)
- {切迫性|せっぱくせい}{尿|にょう}{失禁|しっきん} — urge incontinence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夜尿症|やにょうしょう}→夜尿症：27749_yanyoushou⟧ — bedwetting, nocturnal enuresis (specifically during sleep)
- ⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧ — to leak (colloquial way of describing the act itself)
